# Grant for Broad Institute and Affiliated Researchers


##### May 22, 2026


Each grant winner will receive library preparation and sequencing reagents to analyze eight samples free of charge on the Platinum Pro® located at the Broad Institute. Submit your proposal by May 22, 2026, and winners will be announced in late May or early June!
